metadata.name: Underdrain
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A night-time city crossroads over a sprawling Victorian sewer. Climb down the manholes, drop through the collapsed road or take the storm drain stairs into the great arched interceptor, wade its sewage channel or hold its walkways. The overflow chamber is a cathedral of brick round a deep pool and a waterfall (sniper on the gallery); the pumping station's floodgate lever shuts the sluices and opens the acid bypass. A crumbling floor drops into the flooded cistern, where the rocket launcher waits. Embers hold the west outfall, Tide the pumping station.

do.text: Underdrain: red lamps mark the floodgate levers, in the pump control room and on the outfall terrace.
Floodgates! The interceptor sluices are shutting and the acid bypass is open for 20 seconds.
The sluices are open again; the bypass is sealed.
Floodgates! The interceptor sluices are shutting and the acid bypass is open for 20 seconds.
The sluices are open again; the bypass is sealed.
The penstock and floodgate levers are reset.
Someone has taken the rockets from the cistern.
